Visual Guide to Data Structures

How data is organized, stored, searched, and optimized

From Arrays to LRU Cache

Arrays

Definition: Fixed-size ordered memory blocks.

Access: O(1)

Insert/Delete: O(n)

[10][20][30][40]

Used in image pixels, matrices, buffers.

Linked List

Definition: Nodes linked with pointers.

Traversal: O(n)

Insert: O(1)

10 → 20 → 30 → 40

Useful for dynamic memory structures.

Stack

Rule: Last In First Out (LIFO)

| 3 |
| 2 |
| 1 |

Operations: push(), pop()

Used in recursion, undo, expression parsing.

Queue

Rule: First In First Out (FIFO)

Front → [1][2][3][4] ← Rear

enqueue(), dequeue()

Used in scheduling, BFS, printers.

Deque

Insertion/removal from both ends.

← [1][2][3][4] →

Acts as both stack and queue.

Used in sliding window problems.

HashMap

Stores key-value pairs.

"mom" → 987654321
"id"  → 102

Average lookup: O(1)

Used in dictionaries, caching.

HashSet

Stores only unique values.

{1, 5, 7, 10}

Fast membership checking.

Used in duplicate detection.

Tree

        A
      /   \
     B     C
    / \
   D   E

Hierarchical structure.

Used in DOM, folders, org charts.

Binary Search Tree

      8
     / \
    4   12

Left smaller, right larger.

Search in O(log n) when balanced.

Heap

      1
     / \
    3   5

Priority structure.

MinHeap / MaxHeap.

Used in schedulers, Dijkstra.

Graph

A --- B
|   / |
C --- D

Nodes + edges.

Used in maps, networks, social graphs.

Trie

root
 └ a
   └ p
     └ p

Prefix tree for strings.

Used in autocomplete, spell check.

Disjoint Set

1—2   3—4
Union(2,3)
1—2—3—4

Tracks connected groups.

Used in Kruskal, connectivity.

Bloom Filter

Probabilistic membership structure.

No false negatives.

Possible false positives.

Memory efficient filtering.

LRU Cache

Recent → A B C D ← Old

Evicts least recently used item.

HashMap + Doubly Linked List.

Important: Data structures are tradeoffs. Arrays optimize access, linked lists optimize updates, heaps optimize priority, graphs optimize relationships, and hashmaps optimize lookup.
